metadata.title: Enterprise Policy: Annual Leave Entitlement
metadata.description: HR policy defining annual leave entitlement (20 days per year) and the required notice for leave requests (5 days before start). Applies to all employees under the HRpolicy framework. Status: DRAFT.

props.content: Executive Summary: Employees receive 20 days of annual leave per year, and leave requests must be submitted at least 5 days before the leave starts.
Purpose: This policy establishes the annual leave entitlement and the required notice for leave requests. It applies to all employees under the HR policy framework.

Annual Leave Entitlement means the paid time off allocated to an employee for annual leave, amounting to 20 days per year. Leave Start means the firstday of the requested leave period. Notice Period means the minimum lead time required to submit a leave request, which is 5 days prior to the desired start date. This policy applies to all employees as defined in the HR policy framework.
1. Annual Leave Entitlement: Each eligible employee is entitled to 20 days of annual leave per year. This entitlement is defined by REQ-DEMO-001.
2. Leave Request Notice: Leave requests must be submitted at least 5 days before the leave starts. This requirement is defined by REQ-DEMO-002.
HR / People Operations: Maintain accurate records of leave balances and entitlement; process leave requests in accordance with this policy.
Managers and Supervisors: Review and approve leave requests in a timely manner and ensure notice requirements are observed.
Employees: Submit leave requests with at least 5 days’ notice before the intended start date in accordance with the notice period.
Compliance and enforcement: Non-compliance with entitlement or notice requirements may be addressed through standard internal disciplinary procedures as defined by company policy.
Review and updates: This policy will be reviewed annually by HR and updated as needed.
